root_cause.text: The f_rndis configfs-added class/subclass/protocol fields in `struct f_rndis_opts` were read in `rndis_bind()` without taking the existing `rndis_opts->lock`, allowing concurrent configfs access to race on these shared option values.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly says the "class/subclass/protocol options are susceptible to race conditions as they can be accessed concurrently through configfs," and the patch fixes this by wrapping the reads of `rndis_opts->class`, `rndis_opts->subclass`, and `rndis_opts->protocol` in `scoped_guard(mutex, &rndis_opts->lock)` in `drivers/usb/gadget/function/f_rndis.c`.

intent_record.what: A new header include, #include <linux/cleanup.h>, was added to the file's include list immediately before the existing slab, kernel, and module headers.
intent_record.how: This makes the cleanup helper declarations and macros from linux/cleanup.h available to this compilation unit, enabling use of scoped cleanup functionality at build and runtime where needed; by itself, it does not change observable behavior unless corresponding cleanup constructs are used elsewhere in the file.

intent_record.intent_summary: Protect copying RNDIS option class, subclass, and protocol values into the IAD descriptor with the options mutex to avoid races.
intent_record.what: The direct assignments of rndis_iad_descriptor.bFunctionClass, bFunctionSubClass, and bFunctionProtocol from rndis_opts fields were wrapped inside a scoped_guard(mutex, &rndis_opts->lock) block, adding mutex protection around those three reads.
intent_record.how: At runtime, access to rndis_opts->class, subclass, and protocol is now synchronized with rndis_opts->lock, preventing concurrent updates from racing with descriptor initialization and ensuring the IAD descriptor fields are copied from a consistent, protected state.

The change directly addresses the root cause by adding locking around reads of the RNDIS class/subclass/protocol option fields in bind-time descriptor setup, preventing concurrent configfs races on shared f_rndis_opts values.
